blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Francis Pangilinan did not discount the possibility that the recent school shootings in the country could be tied to efforts to instill fear and instability and “make the government look weak.” While scrutinizing the Department of Justice’s proposed P46.44-billion budget for 2027 on Thursday, Pangilinan aired his concerns about the series of mass shootings in parts of the country that left several students dead. “We have gathered information indicating something unusual or out of the ordinary — three mass shootings in a row, something that had never happened before.
